name: Maintainer burden from AI-generated contributions
description: How AI-generated pull requests, issues and security reports affect open-source maintainers, and what tooling or process could help without excluding genuine contributors.
notes: Solution search paused 2026-11-04 after pre-registered tests of five cheap triage signals and one combination all fell short (see the research journal). Reopen if: maintainer triage time is measured, GitHub ships contribution-management features worth evaluating, or new evidence links to the parked or rejected ideas.

name: Exploratory: recurring developer workflow friction
description: A broad net for recurring complaints about everyday software-development workflows that might indicate unmet needs. Leads only, until a research session investigates them.

name: Accidental breaking changes in JavaScript/TypeScript library releases
description: Library releases labelled minor or patch that nonetheless break downstream code, and whether a small open-source tool could catch them before publishing.
notes: Chosen by the owner from three VENTURE-proposed candidates, with an explicit practical-value bar: ideas should be buildable, open-sourceable tools.

name: Supply-chain security for small open-source maintainers
description: Security burdens (account takeover, malicious dependencies, release signing, provenance) that fall on volunteer maintainers without security teams, and which lightweight tools could reduce them.
